previous_statement: The three real numbers rho_fac, (24*K)^(-1), and 1 are strictly positive: rho_fac>0 and K>0 are supplied by the preceding coefficient facts, hence 24*K>0 and its reciprocal is positive, while 1>0. Therefore their finite minimum eta_K=min{rho_fac,(24*K)^(-1),1}, as defined in (1.8) of def-routef-raw-factor-setting, satisfies eta_K>0.
new_statement: By lem-routef-k-finiteness in the ambient configuration of node 1, rho_fac>0 and K is a finite real scalar; independently, equation (1.6) of def-routef-raw-factor-setting makes K a maximum containing 1, so K>=1>0. Hence rho_fac, (24*K)^(-1), and 1 are all strictly positive. The minimum of finitely many strictly positive real numbers is strictly positive, so equation (1.8), eta_K=min{rho_fac,(24*K)^(-1),1}, gives eta_K>0.
